optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Digital Product Manager, Developer Tools Platform
professionalSummary: Experienced product manager with a proven track record of setting direction for deployment services on internal developer tools platforms, prioritising backlog with platform engineering and engineering teams, and driving automation of deployments.

Successfully increased the share of deployments completed without manual intervention from 62% to 84% within three months of an automated rollback release, as documented in the platform's monthly deployment reports.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the Digital Product Manager, Developer Tools Platform role.

role.roleTitle: Digital Product Manager, Developer Tools Platform

evidence.text: Set the direction for the deployment service on the internal developer tools platform; every sprint I settled the backlog order with platform engineering and a rotating group of the engineering teams that depend on the service.
evidence.notes: Directly states direction setting and backlog ordering with relevant stakeholders.

evidence.text: Chaired the review for all eight deployment-service releases that year and kept the decision log, including what was deferred and why.
evidence.notes: Explicitly mentions chairing release reviews and maintaining decision log.

evidence.text: The share of deployments completed without manual intervention rose from 62 percent to 84 percent in the three months after the automated rollback release, per the platform's monthly deployment report against its documented baseline of 62 percent.
evidence.notes: Provides quantitative baseline and post-intervention metric.

evidence.text: Lined each release up with the platform engineering manager and the consuming teams; dates and the order in which teams were moved over were the platform engineering manager's decisions.
evidence.notes: Shows coordination with platform engineering and consuming teams and record of decisions.

evidence.text: Kept the release notes current; they record, for instance, that automated rollback does not yet cover database migrations, and carry the hand-over notes the platform on-call rota relies on.
evidence.notes: Demonstrates maintenance of release notes and hand-over documentation.

supportedClaims.claim: Set the direction for the deployment service on the internal developer tools platform and prioritized backlog with platform engineering and engineering teams.
supportedClaims.witness: Set the direction for the deployment service on the internal developer tools platform; every sprint I settled the backlog order with platform engineering and a rotating group of the engineering teams that depend on the service.

supportedClaims.claim: Chaired release reviews for all deployment-service releases and maintained a decision log.
supportedClaims.witness: Chaired the review for all eight deployment-service releases that year and kept the decision log, including what was deferred and why.

supportedClaims.claim: Increased the share of deployments completed without manual intervention from 62% to 84% within three months of an automated rollback release.
supportedClaims.witness: The share of deployments completed without manual intervention rose from 62 percent to 84 percent in the three months after the automated rollback release, per the platform's monthly deployment report against its documented baseline of 62 percent.

supportedClaims.claim: Coordinated each release with platform engineering manager and consuming teams, recording decisions on dates and rollout order.
supportedClaims.witness: Lined each release up with the platform engineering manager and the consuming teams; dates and the order in which teams were moved over were the platform engineering manager's decisions.

supportedClaims.claim: Maintained up-to-date release notes with limitations and hand-over information for on-call teams.
supportedClaims.witness: Kept the release notes current; they record, for instance, that automated rollback does not yet cover database migrations, and carry the hand-over notes the platform on-call rota relies on.

humanReviewChecklist: Verify that the candidate’s reported increase in deployment automation aligns with independent audit data.
Confirm the candidate’s role in decision-making for release dates and rollout order beyond the platform engineering manager’s authority.
Ensure that the candidate’s release notes include all required limitations and hand-over details as per platform policy.
